summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration with Spark 4.1, improvements to asynchronous reading for small file workloads, and the introduction of a `write.parquet.page-version` table property. Additionally, proposals for enhanced OAuth2 support and fine-grained access control in Iceberg REST clients are being considered.
highlights: Iceberg-Spark integration work and async reader improvements
Proposal for improved OAuth2 experience in REST clients
Fine Grained Access Control proposal for REST catalogs
